params.body:
Implements Standard 0.16.0 (gentells-standard PR of the same name): patterns need two sources, and an insight rests only on the patterns it shares evidence with.

**Why.** Of the 40 newest insights on 23 October 2026:
- 3 showed five or six patterns on three to six signals;
- 13 held two or three patterns that were one idea;
- 6 rested on one source.

The signal path of suggest.mjs attached up to five patterns by two shared words with the cluster's tension phrase. Its topic and concept terms read fields the store does not return, so they always scored 0. A report chunk (weight 3) reached `minScore` 3 on its own, so every concept it named could become a pattern.

**What changes:**
- `packages/core/pattern-evidence.mjs`: `sharedSignals`, `patternsSharingEvidence` and `patternsBackedBy`, all read from `concept_mentions` and `patterns.concepts`. Archived patterns never count.
- Signal path (`suggest.mjs`): the word matcher is gone. The model's own pattern picks are kept only when they share evidence. The five live patterns that share the most signals with the cluster are added. At write, the insight's patterns are filtered again before the verification gate, so a pattern the model named in pass 2 without evidence goes too.
- Pattern path: after the evidence is gathered (at most three signals per source), the cluster keeps only the patterns those signals mention. A cluster with none left is skipped.
- `detectPatternCandidates`: needs `COUNT(DISTINCT source)` ≥ 2 (`PATTERN_MIN_SOURCES`). A signal without a source row counts by its platform. The constant reads the Standard's `minSources` once `STANDARD_REF` moves to v0.16.0; until then it falls back to 2.
- Weekly prune: a candidate on fewer than 2 sources in its 60-day window is archived at once, unless a live insight holds it. A pattern without concepts is left to the age rule.
- `bin/insight-pattern-evidence.mjs` brings live insights in line:
  - by default a dry run, listing per insight the patterns it keeps and loses, and which lost names its text mentions;
  - `--apply --run=<name>` applies it, with `--undo=<run>` to put it back;
  - it never touches the text.

Tests: `test/pattern-evidence.test.mjs` (5) covers detection, the shared-evidence filter, the prune and the script. `test/source-lifecycle.test.mjs` now adds a second source before it expects a pattern. Full suite 1328/1334; the 6 report-render tests (pdftoppm) fail, as on main. `tsc` is clean.

After deploy, on the box: `node bin/insight-pattern-evidence.mjs --out=/tmp/ipe.json` to look, then `--apply --run=pattern-evidence-1`.
params.title: Patterns need two sources, and an insight rests only on patterns it shares evidence with
